object.title: Institutional Reality as a Correctible Evidence Chain
object.summary: Institutional Reality as a Correctible Evidence Chain is an author-approved methodological working paper (v0.2.0). It specifies a falsifiable evidence-reporting chain and four hypotheses for independent comparison. Bounded internal examples and external public source antecedents do not establish empirical superiority, a validated MIHM model or independent RETURN.

findings.title: Independent external governance and provenance antecedents
findings.summary: NIST AI RMF 1.0 provides a public voluntary risk-management framework; W3C PROV-O is a public 2013 recommendation for provenance representations. Neither source validates SFI.

findings.title: Knight Capital regulator record is retrospective
findings.summary: SEC Exchange Act Release 34-70694 was published October 16, 2013 about Knight Capital August 2012 events; its later findings cannot serve as contemporaneous 2012 operator knowledge.

findings.title: Public bounded SFI documentary derivative is accessible
findings.summary: The existing public Research Hub includes a Knight 2012 retrospective derivative with stated limits. This demonstrates document availability, not prospective MIHM-T prediction or independent SFI validation.

limitations: Not peer reviewed. No DOI assigned. H1-H4 untested; no matched independent evaluation.
Internal SFI-A/SFI-B primary records are not included; external documents are referenced, not relicensed.
No external measured RETURN or universal identity threshold. Funding and conflicts remain undeclared.
